rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Heroes with up to Tough(6) may deploy as part of one multi-model unit without another Hero, but must use the unit's Defense until all other models have been killed.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed.

rules.name: Scout
rules.description: May be deployed after all other units.

traits.name: Leader
traits.description: The Hero and its unit get +1 to Morale Test rolls in melee.
